tasks.name: Reach a target pose
tasks.description: Move the ALOHA 2 selected-arm end effector to a specified tabletop target position without manipulating an object.
tasks.applicability: The ALOHA 2 is a bimanual MuJoCo configuration with two 6-axis arms and joint-position gripper actuators. This is single-arm execution: select one arm, use that arm's gripper site and finger contacts when the task requires contact, and keep the other arm at neutral; it is not a genuine bimanual task. The selected arm can place its gripper site at a reachable tabletop target position without manipulating an object.
tasks.adaptation: Adapt a direct reach to the canonical ALOHA 2 configuration using only the selected arm and its private scene fixtures. Preserve the source scoring metric "end_effector_target_distance", m unit, comparator "<=", and threshold 0.05; the source numerical obligation is unchanged. This catalog records applicability only and makes no task execution or task-passing claim.
scene_assumptions: A fixed target body is placed in the reachable tabletop workspace.
The private scene provides collision-free free space for the end effector to approach the target.
observation_assumptions: The observation exposes end-effector position and target position in a common metre frame.
The private measurement binding can evaluate the terminal Euclidean position error.
